decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed garage and flank  extension  would not have a detrimental effect on the house or  the surrounding properties and approval is advised.   It is considered that this application for a replacement garage, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 
3 Mandeville Road and is complimentary to the visual amenity of the locality and would not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and  T 1.4  (Car and Cycle  parking  and servicing facilities for developments)	
of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the west wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing No. 04b shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.
description: Demolition of existing garage and the erection of a single storey side/rear extension for use as a garage to existing dwellinghouse.
